# Will you get a 1099-K this year?

> Check whether a marketplace, payment app, or platform is likely to send you a Form 1099-K, per platform and per tax year. Covers the federal threshold's four changes since 2022 ($20,000/200 transactions, $5,000 in 2024, back to $20,000/200 from 2025 on) plus the four states with their own stricter $600 rule.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
